title: The first ordinary integral-reduced coefficient line in canonical root coordinates
statement: Fix the finite-coefficient setting [def-pur-conventions] and the actual integral-reduced signed lines in [def-pur-finite-tensor-reduction-data]. For a scheme T over k, ell is a unit in its global sections. Use the root-projection-normalized site comparison [lem-amb-finite-tate-site-descent] followed by the inverse realization comparison [def-sf-orientation-finite-line-comparisons]. Transport only the positive-level indexing: the comparison from the published first finite etale root sheaf to the actual fixed-scalar first line is uniquely characterized by equality with that specified composite for every representation n=j+1. Its degree-zero derived comparison, followed by the primitive-root trivialization of [def-pur-finite-reduction-root-charts] and the comparison-unit chart, defines the first-root chart. The zero signed line has the coefficient-unit chart given by [def-pur-proetale-constant-module-unit] and the intrinsic realization unit. The single/unit composite is the native comparison of [def-pur-finite-tensor-comparison-equations].

source.place: Proof Step 2: compatibility with the invertible twist by associativity of derived tensor, all signed twists and shifts; returned proof Step 1 (twist part)

proof.text: For each point of T, coefficientPrime_isUnit_stalk from the finite setting gives invertibility of ell. The local criterion for units of a ringed space gives finiteTensorPrimeIsUnit on global sections; germ maps preserve natural-number casts. This also covers the empty scheme.

Eliminate the finite-setting record and its positive level. The zero case contradicts positivity. At level n+1 take the composite of finite_tate_site_descent at exponent n and the inverse of sfOrientationFixedRootSheaf_existsUnique. Prove explicitly that finiteTensorLine T 1 equals finiteCoefficientTwist at predecessor n: degree one is the first line, and its transport is reflexive after reducing (n+1)-1. Rewrite the fixed-scalar target by that equality to transport the specified composite, preserving it by HEq.

For any representation of the level as j+1, successor injectivity gives j=n, and the required heterogeneous equality is reflexivity. Any other candidate satisfies that equality at n, so eq_of_heq proves it equals the specified composite. The zero and primitive-root charts retain their existing definitions.
